title: Running stitch
description: A loader sewn around a circle, then unpicked.
alt: Two rings of short dashes, peach outside and linen inside, are drawn around a circle in opposite directions while turning once, then removed.
note: A dashed line cannot be drawn on with stroke-dashoffset, because the dashes are already using it; asking for an animated mask solves that. Review caught a doubled stitch where the dash period did not divide the circumference, and a jump at the loop seam from turning only half way.
author: Maria Roszyk
